name: intertwine
source:
A recurring dream. A flash of deja vu. An undeniable connection.

Some say these are remnants of our past lives—echoes of the memories we’ve made in centuries past. When I ran into you on that fateful day…

I started to believe them.

[from [url=https://crescence-studio.itch.io/intertwine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个反复出现的梦。似曾相识的一闪。不可否认的联系。

有人说这些是我们前世的遗迹——我们几个世纪以来记忆的回声。当我在那决定性的一天遇见你时……

我开始相信他们。

[来自[url=https://crescence-studio.itch.io/intertwine]itch.io[/url]]
